title: Introduction and overview — Astute-class Submarine
description: Introduction and overview of the Astute-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Royal Navy's Astute class — seven planned, built by BAE Systems — are Britain's largest and most capable attack submarines: 7,400 tons with Tomahawk missiles and Spearfish torpedoes. The program suffered delays and cost overruns but delivered exceptionally quiet boats; they will serve into the 2040s. Baseline facts: Royal Navy attack submarine; 7 planned; 7,400 tons; Tomahawk capable..
